sports.name: Lake to Ocean: A Nature Walk
sports.address: 1 Harding Rd, San Francisco, CA 94132, USA, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: For golden-hour ocean and city views, wildlife spotting, and an easy paved group walk.
sports.summary: A free, 3-mile group nature walk starting at 1 Harding Road (Lake Merced) that meets at 5:00 p.m.; look for the green picnic tables by the statue of King Carlos III. Typical route follows Lake Merced up to the Fort Funston observation deck with ocean and city views, or alternately goes past the zoo to Sunset Dunes; paths are fully paved.

sports.name: Squash in the Mission (Tuesday)
sports.why: Play a free pickup squash game and meet local players.
sports.summary: A weekly squash group that meets at the courts in Mission Recreation Center on Tuesdays. Sessions are free, and the venue is close to the 16th and 24th Street BART stations with street parking nearby.

sports.name: SF Underwater Hockey Beginners Game
sports.address: 5701 3rd St (At Carroll Ave, near Candlestick Park), San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Try a low-contact, fast-paced aquatic team sport with coaching and gear provided.
sports.summary: A beginners' underwater hockey session at Martin Luther King Pool where trained coaches teach the rules and play; first game free and equipment is available if needed. The event is coed and open to all ages, swimmers encouraged to attend.
